meta.existing_rent: Census actual net cold rent paid by renting households, not 2025 new asking rents
meta.vacant_12mo_share: Percentage of all vacant dwellings vacant for 12+ months; NOT percentage of all dwellings
meta.available_3mo_share: Percentage of all vacant dwellings reported as available for occupancy within 3 months; NOT equivalent to market-active multi-family rental vacancy
meta.available_3mo_total_share: Same 3mo-available vacancies divided by all dwellings in buildings with living space; DIFFERENT denominator
meta.census_2022_vs_HA26_vacancy: Census LEQ housing universe is not assumed identical to Deutschlandatlas BBSR wohn_leer
meta.suppression: Unknown or withheld values retained as null; totals can differ slightly due confidentiality adjustments
